spec: Prepare detached engine-owned presentation geometry from authoritative initial map facts before mounting a battle or replacing a dropped export. Exact distance access supports bounded arbitrary boards without quadratic tables.
expect: Unknown IDs, resized known IDs and changed ground/props mount through the same passive component. Invalid facts reject before replacement; initial events, seek/step parity, registered CLI bytes, all existing replays and controls remain unchanged. Thin 1x300 distances and 10000-cell preparation stay exact and bounded.
note: Readonly presentation boundary only, no combat rules or event changes; canonical event props allow normalized shorthand IDs, raw authoring retains its existing stricter boundary. No registry mutation or new exemptions.
